outline:
先修課程：3002012或負責教授同意。介紹各種不同分析方法（如能量法及Castigliano定理）、破壞理論、材料選用、可靠度概念、軸及軸承、離合器及煞車器、傳動元件(如皮帶、鏈條、齒輪)、軸聯接器、飛輪、彈簧等。
Prerequisite: ME212 or Consent of Instructor Introduction to Analysis Methods (Energy method & Castigliano theorem),
Failure Theory, Material Selection, Introduction to reliability, Shafts and Bearings, Clutches and Brakes, Power Transmission Elements (Belts, Chains, Gears), Couplings, Flywheels, and Springs.
schedule:
Week 	Topic
1	Course introduction & Mechanical Design in Broad Perspective
2 	Elastic strain, Deflection, and Stability
3	Failure Theories, Safety Factors, and Reliability
4	Fatigue (I)
5	Fatigue (II)
6	Threaded Fasteners and Power Screws (I)
7	Threaded Fasteners and Power Screws (II)
8	Rivets, Welding, and Bonding
9	Mid-term exam
10	Springs (I)
11	Springs (II)
12	Spur Gears (I)
13	Spur Gears (II)
14	Shafts and Associated Parts (I)
15	Shafts and Associated Parts (II)
16	Final exam
17	Flexible Learning (see Note)
18	Flexible Learning (see Note)

category: 線上數位教材學習(Coursera、edX、磨課師等)(Online digital learning (Coursera, edX, MOOCs, etc.))
flexible_learning.content: 本學期課程採16+2週教學方式，第17-18二周採彈性自主學習，請同學利用該二周時間至Coursera網站搜尋相關本學期課程之相關課程挑選二個章節(共6小時)進行自主學習。
flexible_learning.outcome: 於第18週上傳二頁之心得報告至網路i-學園中，報告內容敘述學習內容並說明線上課程與本學期之實體課程之差異及優缺點。
flexible_learning.assessment_ratio: 報告內容將採計學期成績5%

assessment:
1. 出席與上課參與 10%
2. 作業 15%
3. 期中考 30%
4. 期末考 40%
5. 自主學習報告 5%
